confidence_rationale: Canonical, heavily-cited Neuron synthesis of the theta-gamma multiplexing code with broad hippocampal + cortical empirical support. Directly grounds MECH-089 (theta-gamma nesting packages E1 for E3) at near-mechanism fidelity and supplies the formal capacity argument (~7+/-2 = gamma-cycles-per-theta) that grounds the 'both mechanisms multiply representational capacity' claim in the object-binding design fork. Held below 0.8 because the capacity-extension mapping to ARC-080 is at the class level and because phase-coded multiplexing presupposes a slot/item layer REE does not yet have.
failure_signatures: Theta-gamma multiplexing presupposes discrete items to assign to gamma subcycles; with no slot/token layer (REE's current state) there are no items to multiplex and the phase code has nothing to carry -- the capacity advantage is unrealizable until slots exist.
Capacity is bounded (~7+/-2 gamma cycles per theta cycle); the scheme extends, but does not remove, a hard simultaneous-item limit.

mapping.source_claim_statement: Neural information is organized by a dual oscillatory code: individual items are represented in gamma subcycles that are nested within a theta cycle, with the ORDER of items encoded by gamma phase within theta. This multiplexing both segments items (each gamma cycle = one item) and encodes their sequence, yielding a natural capacity of roughly the number of gamma cycles per theta cycle (~7).
mapping.ree_translation: Near-direct grounding for MECH-089 (theta-gamma nesting packages E1 updates into theta-cycle summaries for E3 -- E3 never sees raw E1). Also supplies the formal backbone of the object-binding design-fork claim that synchrony/phase and slots are COMPLEMENTARY: phase-multiplexing makes effective capacity ~ (items/slots) x (phase bins) rather than just (slots). Bears on ARC-080 as the capacity-extension mechanism that a slot layer would be multiplexed by.
mapping.mapping_caveat: The evidence base is hippocampal/cortical LFP and spike-phase coding in rodents (with human EEG/MEG support); REE's heartbeat is an engineered control-plane rhythm over latents, not spiking populations. The mapping to MECH-089 is strong at the class level (theta-gamma IS what MECH-089 names), but the capacity-multiplication benefit is unrealizable in REE until a slot/item layer exists for phase to organize -- exactly the gap the 641a null exposed.
mapping.source_context: Review/perspective synthesizing rodent hippocampal and cortical electrophysiology plus human EEG/MEG on cross-frequency (theta-gamma) coupling and working-memory capacity.

confidence_components.notes: High source quality (canonical Neuron review). Mapping fidelity good for MECH-089 (theta-gamma is the named mechanism), moderate for the ARC-080 capacity claim. Transfer risk from spike-phase coding to REE's engineered heartbeat is real but bounded -- MECH-089 was designed as this analog.
